title: Crown Him With Many Crowns
lyrics_original: Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His Throne;
Hark! How the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own.
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for me,
And hail Him as my matchless King
Through all eternity.
Crown Him the Lord of Life,
Who triumphed over the grave,
And rose victorious in the strife
For those He came to save.
His glories now we sing,
Who died, and rose on high,
Who died eternal life to bring,
And lives that death may die.
Crown Him the Lord of Peace,
Whose power a scepter sways
From pole to pole, that wars may cease,
And all be prayer and praise.
His reign shall know no end,
And round His piercèd feet
Fair flowers of paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.
Crown Him the Lord of Heav'n,
Enthroned in worlds above,
Crown Him the King to Whom is giv'n
The wondrous name of Love
Crown Him with many crowns,
As thrones before Him fall;
Crown Him, ye kings, with many crowns,
For He is King of all.
Crown Him the Lord of Love,
Behold His hands and side,
Those wounds, yet visible above,
In beauty glorified.
All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For Thou has died for me;
Thy praise and glory shall not fail
Throughout eternity.

bible_verses.english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross. Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name; that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You alone are worthy of all honor, glory, and praise. Thank You for laying down Your life for me and conquering death so that I might live in Your victory. Awake my heart today to behold Your royalty and to render my life as an offering to You. Reign supreme in my thoughts, desires, and actions, both now and for all eternity. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Crown Him With Many Crowns invites us to join our voices with the song of heaven, declaring Jesus as the ultimate King over life, death, and eternity. As we sing, we are reminded that the Lamb who sacrificed Himself is the same victorious Lord who conquered the grave. This song calls our souls to awaken from distraction and place Christ at the very center of our lives. Today, let His matchless love stir your heart to surrender every area of your life to His gentle, triumphant reign.
